name: advance-codex
description: Capability plugin for strengthening Codex surfaces across skills, scenario testing, product planning judgment, engineering judgment, design judgment, agent token optimization, commits, and plugins.

interface.shortDescription: Strengthen skills, product planning, engineering and design judgment, agent token optimization, scenario testing, commits, and plugins.
interface.longDescription: Provides skills for strengthening Codex surfaces: shaping reusable skills, applying product planning judgment to user problems, scope, requirements, acceptance criteria, priorities, tradeoffs, and handoffs, applying problem-solving-centered engineering judgment, applying product design judgment across UI, UX, interface content, and quality, reducing agent wording tokens without losing correctness or verification evidence, testing reusable instructions with fixed scenarios and fresh executors, finalizing Codex-made changes into stable commits, and packaging plugins.
defaultPrompt: When a skill is needed, forget previously loaded skill context and reread the current skill body before applying it.
Use $advance-codex:plugin-creator to package a plugin and define the right bundled surfaces.
Use $advance-codex:skill-creator to design a reusable Codex skill with the right references, guardrails, and description trigger metadata.
Use $advance-codex:skill-scenario-testing to test reusable instructions with fresh subagents, fixed scenarios, and caller-side metrics before reporting evidence-backed findings.
Use $advance-codex:git-committer to prepare and execute a task-scoped commit with commit authority checks, staged verification, commit-message hygiene, and post-commit confirmation.

Use $advance-codex:pro-planner to apply product and service planning judgment to user problems, target users, product value, MVP scope, requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, tradeoffs, release slices, and designer/engineer handoff contracts.
Use $advance-codex:pro-engineering to apply problem-solving-centered engineering judgment to code changes, root cause analysis, implementation discipline, verification, and risk reporting.

Use $advance-codex:pro-designer to apply product design judgment to screens, user flows, interface content, color, tone and expression, branding, space and composition, surface and form, and product quality through UI, UX, Content, Color, Tone & Expression, Branding, Space & Composition, Surface & Form, and Quality criteria.

Use $advance-codex:optimize-token to reduce agent wording tokens in responses, progress updates, status notes, verification notes, and approval boundaries while preserving correctness, verification evidence, approval boundaries, required output format, and current-state accuracy.
